description: Unpublish a post from one or all platforms. Removes the post from the social media platform but keeps the post record in SocialAPI. Optionally specify account_id to unpublish from a single platform only; omit to unpublish from all. This is irreversible on the platform side.

account_id.description: Account ID to unpublish from (omit for all)

name: social_api_unpublish_post
title: Unpublish Post
